description: This Swift source file defines a DeepLinkHandler class responsible for processing custom URL schemes relevant to the OpenClaw application. It includes logic for validating, parsing, and handling deep links related to agent commands and gateways, with logging, alert presentation, and session management. It also defines protocols for effective delivery, validation errors, and configuration constants specific to deep linking functionality.

classes.name: DeepLinkHandler
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for handling incoming deep link URLs, validating them, prompting the user, and performing associated actions such as sending agent commands via gateway connections.

methods.name: handle(url: URL)
methods.description: Main entry point to handle an incoming URL; parses and processes agent or gateway deep links asynchronously.

methods.name: handleAgent(link: AgentDeepLink, originalURL: URL)
methods.description: Handles agent-specific deep links, including message validation, user prompting, and invoking gateway requests.

methods.name: currentKey()
methods.description: Returns the currently stored deep link key from user defaults.

methods.name: currentCanvasKey()
methods.description: Returns the in-memory generated key used for canvas unattended deep links.

methods.name: expectedKey()
methods.description: Generates or retrieves the expected deep link key from user defaults, generating a new one if necessary.

methods.name: generateRandomKey()
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure random string for use as a deep link key.

methods.name: confirm(title: String, message: String)
methods.description: Displays an NSAlert to confirm user action; returns true if user confirms.

methods.name: presentAlert(title: String, message: String)
methods.description: Displays an informational NSAlert with given title and message.
